# Console commands for the smoke test, one per line. "wait <seconds>" pauses.
chk version
chk list
chk keepchunk coords 3 4 world
chk chunkinfo coords 3 4 world
chk releasechunk coords 3 4 world
kc keepregion coords 20 20 22 21 world
ck chunkinfo coords 20 20 22 21 world
keepchunks releaseregion coords 20 20 22 21 world
chk keepregion coords 0 0 1000 1000 world
# A small railway across chunk borders: 41 rails along x, 10 along z
minecraft:forceload add 992 992 1072 1024
# Folia loads force-loaded chunks in the background, so give it a moment before /fill
wait 8
minecraft:fill 1000 199 1000 1040 199 1000 stone
minecraft:fill 1000 200 1000 1040 200 1000 rail
minecraft:fill 1040 199 1001 1040 199 1010 stone
minecraft:fill 1040 200 1001 1040 200 1010 rail
minecraft:forceload remove all
chk keeprail coords 1020 200 1000 world
wait 3
chk releaserail coords 1020 200 1000 world
wait 3
# Named areas next to single chunks, including overlaps
chk keepregion coords 30 30 31 31 world --name testarea
chk keepchunk coords 30 30 world
chk releasechunk coords 30 30 world
chk chunkinfo coords 30 30 world
chk keepregion coords 30 30 31 31 world --name testarea
chk keepregion coords 1 1 1 1 world --name Bad.Name
chk area rename testarea farm
chk area list
chk keeprail coords 1020 200 1000 world --name line
wait 3
chk keepregion coords 61 61 62 62 world --name overlap
chk area release line
chk area release overlap
# Convert single chunks into an area and back, without unloading anything
chk keepregion coords 40 40 41 41 world
chk area convert block coords 40 40 42 42 world
chk chunkinfo coords 40 40 world
chk area convert block coords 40 40 42 42 world
chk area convert nothing coords 50 50 51 51 world
chk area dissolve block
chk chunkinfo coords 41 41 world
chk releaseregion coords 40 40 41 41 world
chk area convert imported world world
chk area dissolve imported
chk reload
chk releaseall confirm
chk list
